text_simplified: Nail-biting is a common behavior in children. It may cause damage to the skin, leading to redness and swelling. It is important to monitor the child and provide them with safe alternatives to benefit from.
title: Qadm al-Athafir 'inda al-Atfal (Nail-Biting in Children)

review_defects.why: The transliteration of الأظافر as 'al-Athafir' is incorrect: the Arabic letter is ظ (ẓā'), not ث (thā'). It should be transliterated as al-Aẓāfir or al-Azafir.

review_defects.english: provide them with safe alternatives to benefit from
review_defects.why: The Arabic says 'safe things' (أشياء آمنة), not 'safe alternatives'. Adding 'alternatives' introduces a meaning not present in the source.

review_defects.english: It is important to monitor the child and provide them
review_defects.why: The Arabic uses a direct obligation 'يجب' (must/should), while the English softens it to 'It is important to', making the guidance less direct.
